blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Senate impeachment court on Monday granted Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte’s request to appear before it on Tuesday and Wednesday. His request was contained in a letter to the impeachment court on Monday, according to Presiding Officer and Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero. READ: Baste Duterte, other witnesses subpoenaed for Sara impeachment trial Escudero said the mayor requested that “he be given time as he requires substantial time to gather, organize, authenticate, and reproduce the subpoenaed documents and asks that he be allowed to attend instead of today, tomorrow, and on Wednesday, for him to be allowed […]...
